IN THE COURT OF HON’BLE XII ADDL. CHIEF METROPOLITAN MAGISTRATE AT NAMPALLY HYDERABAD.
Honored Sir,

	Today i.e. on 05.01.2024 at 21:20 hours received an English typed complaint from Mr. Eroboina Ramu S/o Late E. Suresh Age: 30 years Occ: Private Service (Reliance Smart Point, Kokapet) R/o H.No. 18-5-146, Shalibanda, Rajanna Bowli, Phoolbagh Chaman Playground, Hyderabad, and the facts are as follows.

	             The brief facts of the case are that the complainant Mr. Eroboina Ramu, residing at H.No. 18-5-146, Shalibanda, Rajanna Bowli, Phoolbagh Chaman Playground, Hyderabad, wherein he stated that he has been working as a Manager at Reliance Smart Point for the past two years, having previously served at Lifestyle Store, Begumpet, Hyderabad, for a duration of five years. During his period at Lifestyle, the complainant developed a close association with Mr. Kotha Srikanth, who was a Cashier at the same establishment. Upon Mr. Kotha Srikanth's departure from Lifestyle, he initiated various businesses, including Travel, Wholesale/Retail of Groceries, Saloon, and Coca Cola distribution. Mr. Kotha Srikanth approached the complainant with an investment proposition, assuring a consistent 4% monthly profit. Trusting Mr. Srikanth's assurances, he invested a total of Rs 40 Lakhs in these ventures through credit card swipes and personal loans from various banks and online payment apps from 2020 until October 2023. Regrettably, Mr. Srikanth has failed to honor his commitment, repaying only Rs 7,00,000/- to date. This has resulted in a substantial outstanding amount of Rs 33,00,000/-, placing the complainant under significant pressure from banks seeking repayment of credit card bills and personal loans. Furthermore, it has come to light that Mr. Srikanth has engaged in similar fraudulent activities with other friends and colleagues from Lifestyle Store, extracting amounts from them under the guise of investment and subsequently cheated them. The details of the amounts received by Mr. Kotha Srikanth from various victims are as follows:
1.	Eroboina Ramu (Complainant): Rs 33,00,000
2.	L. Ramesh Babu: Rs 9,00,000
3.	P. Ashween Kumar: Rs 13,00,000
4.	Kathi Ranjith Kumar: Rs 17,34,117
5.	Nandyala Rajender Reddy: Rs 11,29,954
The cumulative amount cheated from all victims, including the complainant totals Rs 83,64,071/-. Hence the complainant requests to take necessary legal action against Mr. Kotha Srikanth for his fraudulent activities. 
//The Original complaint is enclosed herewith for kind perusal//
Received on 05.01.2024 at 21:20 hours: 
		As per the endorsement of DCP, DD, CCS, Hyderabad and as per the contents of the above complaint I, SI T. Narsing Rao, Chair Duty, CCS, DD, Hyd., registered a case in Cr. No. 09/2024, U/s 406 420 IPC and case file handed over to Sri. S. Srinivasa Chary, Inspector, EOW Team -X, CCS, DD, Hyd. for further investigation.
                                                                                        Sd/-
                                                                              (T. Narsing Rao)
	                                                      SI of Police, Chair Duty,  CCS, DD, Hyd

IN THE COURT OF HON’BLE XII ADDL. CHIEF METROPOLITAN MAGISTRATE AT NAMPALLY HYDERABAD.
Honored Sir,

	Today i.e. on 05.01.2024 at 21:00 hours received an English typed complaint from Mr. Mullapudi Prahalada Kumar S/o Venkat Rao Age: 53 years Occ: Service R/o H.No. 4-4-16 Flat No. 202, Royal Towers, Nidadavoluvari Veedi, Tanuku, West Godawari, and the facts are as follows.

	            The brief facts of the case are that the complainant Mr. Mullapudi Prahalada Kumar S/o Venkat Rao Age: 53 years Occ: Service R/o HNo. 4-4-16 Flat No. 202, Royal Towers, Nidadavoluvari Veedi, Tanuku, West Godawari wherein he representing on behalf of Sri Manne Ramakrishna. Sri Manne Ramakrishna hails from Chevatam (V), Undrajavaram (M), West Godavari, Andhra Pradesh, and is currently residing and working in the USA. The parents of Mr. Manne Ramakrishna, namely Sri Manne Shivaiah and Smt. Manne Satyavathi, were residents of Chevatam village. In August 2020, Mr. Manne Ramakrishna was informed that his parents had contracted Covid-19. In response, he contacted Sri Akula Bhavani Shankar Rao, the proprietor of Sri Surya Ambulance Service, and arranged for an ambulance to transport his parents to the Covid testing center in Undrajavaram.

		Following the tests, the ambulance safely returned his parents to their residence. Later that same day, Mr. Manne Ramakrishna requested the ambulance once again to shift his parents to Hyderabad for further treatment. In compliance with his request, the ambulance owner, Mr. Bhavani Shankar Rao, dispatched the ambulance along with driver Mr. Naga Venkata Shiva Satyanarayana to facilitate the transfer of Ramakrishna's parents to a hospital in Hyderabad. The ambulance arrived in Hyderabad on 17.08.2020 at approximately 09:00 AM, dropping them at Mapmygenome diagnostic Centre, Madhapur. The subsequent test results, received around 2:15 PM, confirmed that both parents had tested positive for Covid-19. Thereafter, the ambulance driver shifted Ramakrishna's parents to Medicover Hospital, Hi-Tec City. Notably, no family members accompanied them during the transfer. Regrettably, Mr. Manne Ramakrishna's father passed away after two months of treatment at Apollo Hospital on 17.10.2020.

		Additionally, it is brought to attention that Mr. Manne Ramakrishna was dismayed to discover that his sister, Smt. Lingamaneni Yashoda Sarada, in collaboration with her husband Lingamaneni Rama Krishna, residing in Hyderabad, allegedly forged their father's signatures on a Will Deed dated 15.08.2020. The said document was purportedly notarized by Nirupa Rai, Advocate in Hyderabad, on 17.08.2020. As a result, they gained possession of the land measuring Ac. 1.79 cents in Chevatam(V) & Tetali (V), originally purchased with the hard-earned money of Mr. Manne Ramakrishna's father, Shivaiah. The land had been registered in the name of the deceased Shivaiah, causing wrongful loss to Mr. Manne Ramakrishna and wrongful gain to Smt. Lingamaneni Yashoda Sarada and Sri Lingamaneni Ramakrishna. Hence the complainant requested to take legal action against Lingamaneni Yashoda Sarada, &  Lingamaneni Ramakrishna as per the law.
//The Original complaint is enclosed herewith for kind perusal//
Received on 05.01.2024 at 21:00 hours: 
		As per the endorsement of DCP, DD, CCS, Hyderabad and as per the contents of the above complaint I, SI T. Narsing Rao, Chair Duty, CCS, DD, Hyd., registered a case in Cr. No. 08/2024, U/s 420, 467, 468, 471 r/w 34 IPC and case file handed over to Sri. N. Anand, Inspector, EOW Team -XI, CCS, DD, Hyd. for further investigation.                 Sd/-
                                                                                 (T. Narsing Rao)
	                                                          SI of Police, Chair Duty,  CCS, DD, Hyd

IN THE COURT OF HONOURABLE IX ADDL.METROPOLITAN MAGISTRATE AT KUKATPALLY, CYBERABAD.
Honoured Sir,
               Brief facts of the case are that on 04-01-2024 at 1640 hours received a complaint Mr. Gautam Anand S/o Ramanugrah Jha, Age 47 years, Education: MBA, Occp: Delivery Manager in Private company, R/o Flat#105, SVS Vaibhav, Pipeline Road, Petbasheerabad, Hyderabad Mobile No: 9391167573. In which he stated that on 25/12/2023, he received Whatsapp message from Ankita (+62 8313855-85500) in English language and during conversation said that they are looking for people who can help them increase the likes and provide five star ratings for hotels/restaurants in google map. This is what their company works for, and you will get paid for doing the task. The job is to provide five star ratings to hotels/restaurants. They will give 22 tasks in a day, and you will get paid accordingly. She asked him to contact the receptionist in TELEGRAM with id @aakanksha1986. Ms. Aakanksha asked him to join in a group where the tasks are assigned to provide five star ratings to hotels/resturants. Where one person who is the owner of the group posts the tasks to provide five star. Once we complete the task, we have to share the screenshots of the completed tasks. After completion of 3 tasks, they ask to share the same screenshot to @aakanksha1986 and by providing bank details they transfer the amount in our account. On completion of 3 tasks for completion of 4th task he asked me to contact teacher @junaid1176 and he said he need to register an account in http://7tb4.in  without any Invitation code. There is no fee for registering an account. After successful login they confirmed with merchant. He then asked for every task, to deposit prepaid amount in the account that will be provided by receptionist (@aakanksha). On verification of payment deposited again he will ask to connect with Teacher(@junaid) And sent 1000 INR and they credited him 1300rs INR for completing the task. He kept giving such prepaid tasks saying the merchant wants you to complete all the tasks to get full profits. Below tasks were provided with different amounts (1000, 3000, 5000, 11000, 15000, 33000, 54000, 100000 upto 30lakhs). Every time he would say one more task came, then he would say you made a mistake, you must pay the correction amount (6,00,000 paid) to complete the ladder to withdraw. So, to rectify it and get all the principal amount (with profits), you will have to finish one more tasks. Finally he asked me to pay 6,00,000 for withdrawing money with profit and at this point he could sense that he trapped and hence didn’t pay. Complt said he have no money and he said that this is the condition and you must pay it and get the money back. It was too late when he realized that it was fraud. Complt transferred the amount total of Rs. 11,55,700/- to their bank accounts/UPI IDs through his bank accounts. They kept showing the virtual profit (17,67,610) in their application and asked him to pay 6,00,000 more and receive all the money. On that moment he could realize that it is fraud. Complt request you to take necessary legal action against Owner & Management of fraudulent domains, http://7tb4.in, Telegram users: @aakanksha1986, @junaid1176, Suspect Bank Account Holders and other beneficiaries from his funds, Whatsapp User: 9391167573 for causing wrongful loss of his amount of Rs.11,55,700/-
Hence the FIR.
(ORIGINAL COMPLAINT ENCLOSED HERE WITH)
Received on 04-01-2024 at 1640 hours:
----------------------------------------------------
As per the above Content, I M. Ranjith Kumar, SI of Police, registered a case in Cr. No. 55/2024, U/Sec 420 IPC and Sec 66-D of IT Act 2000-2008 and case file handed over to Sri. D. Ajay Kumar, Inspector of Police, CCPS, Cyberabad for investigation.
							      Sd/-
		  				  (M. Ranjith Kumar)
		   					  SI of Police
					     Cyber Crime PS, Cyberabad.

IN THE COURT OF HONOURABLE ADDL. JUDICIAL FIRST CLASS MAGISTRATE AT SANGAREDDY

Honored Sir/Madam,  

The brief facts of the case are that on 02-01-2024 at 15:00 hours, I, SI of Police, Sangareddy Rural PS received credible information that some persons are keeping Explosive Substances at Sri Laxmi Narsimha Stones & Rocks Pvt. Limited, Erdanur village. Accordingly I along with my staff raided on Sri Laxmi Narsimha Stones & Rocks Pvt. Limited, Erdanur village along with two panch witnesses i.e., (1) Sri. Lakavath Kumar Naik s/o Man Singh, age: 30 yrs, caste: ST (Lambada), occ: Business, R/o: H.No. 7-41, Gudithanda village, Sangareddy mandal & district and (2) Sri. Darshanam Srihari s/o Sudarshan, age: 35 yrs, caste: SC (Madiga), occ: Business, R/o: Mamidipally village, Kandi mandal, Sangareddy district and found (1) 44 boxes contained 8800 gelatin sticks, and loose 100 gelatin sticks, grand total 8900 gelatin sticks. These gelatin sticks are having in orange colour and each one having 8 inches height and 1 inch dia. There gelatin sticks are used as blasting substances and also found (2) 21 packets of electrical detonators, each packet having 50 electrical detonators and loose 60 electrical detonators. Grand total 1110 electrical detonators are found and also found (3) 17 MS Delay Detonators in the old damaged mini goods vehicle bearing number AP16TB7273. The accused persons (1) Raghuvaran, SR mining, (2) Bhoom Reddy, Sahasra Enterprises and (3) Aadi Vishnu, Minings Engineer and Safety Manager were preserved the above explosive substances without having any permission and license from the concerning authority. If the above explosive substances blast, it is endanger to the life of surrounding residents. Further I have seized all the above explosive substances along with the mini goods vehicle in the presence of above said two mediators under a cover of scene of offence cum seizure panchanama and pasted their signed paper slips on them.   

Returned to PS on 02-01-2024 at 18.30 hours 

               Basing on the scene of offence cum seizure panchanama, I, SIP Sangareddy Rural registered a Sue-Motto Case in Cr. No. 3/2024 U/s 5 & 6 of Explosive Substance Act 1908 and took up the investigation. (The Original Scene of offence cum seizure Panchanama is enclosed here with).

                                                                                                  M. Rajesh Naik
                                                                                             Sub-Inspector of Police,
                                                                                                 Sangareddy Rural P.S.
